7 Brew Salted Honey Chai Latte: Price, Calories & Recipe

A medium Salted Honey Chai Latte is about $4.65, with 300 calories, 0 mg of caffeine and 60 g of sugar. Every number here comes from 7 Brew's own published nutrition guide, broken out by size and preparation.

Salted Honey Chai Latte allergens

7 Brew's published allergen guide lists Milk for the Salted Honey Chai Latte. Adding a milk, syrup or topping changes this, and every drink is made on shared equipment, so cross-contact is possible.

If you are ordering around an allergy, check the full allergen and dietary guide and confirm at the window.

How to order a Salted Honey Chai Latte

Ask for it by name — it is on the standard board at every 7 Brew, so no special script is needed. Say the size first, then the drink: "Can I get a medium Salted Honey Chai Latte?"

Worth knowing before you order: the base is customisable. You can swap milk, ask for sugar-free syrups, change the sweetness level, or have most drinks made iced, hot or blended as a frozen chiller where the menu allows. Ordering through the app earns 100 rewards points either way.

Make a Salted Honey Chai Latte at Home (Copycat Recipe)

Chai plus two syrups. The trick is balance: the salted caramel should season the honey, not bury the chai spices. Start with the amounts below and adjust the caramel down if the spice disappears.

For one medium Salted Honey Chai Latte

  • 6 oz spiced chai concentrate
  • 6 oz milk
  • 1/2 oz honey syrup (or 1 tablespoon honey, dissolved warm)
  • 1/2 oz salted caramel syrup
  • A full cup of ice for the iced version
  1. Stir the honey and salted caramel into the chai concentrate.
  2. Add the milk and pour over ice, or steam everything together for hot.
  3. Taste before adding anything else. This drink runs sweet fast.

Dirty version: add a shot of espresso, a known fan order. Lighter version: half the syrups (1/4 oz each) with skim or almond milk. There is no true sugar-free home version either, for the same reason as at the stand: honey does not come sugar-free.

7 Brew Salted Honey Chai Latte FAQ

How many calories are in a 7 Brew Salted Honey Chai Latte?

A medium iced Salted Honey Chai Latte has 300 calories. A small has 230 and a large 380, according to 7 Brew's nutrition guide.

How much caffeine is in a 7 Brew Salted Honey Chai Latte?

7 Brew does not publish a caffeine figure for its chai drinks, so there is no official number. Fan sites print three different invented sets for this drink (6 to 32 mg, about 70 mg, 40 to 120 mg), which tells you they are guessing. Chai is black-tea based, so it is not caffeine-free, just far below the coffee drinks.

How much does a 7 Brew Salted Honey Chai Latte cost?

Roughly $3.95 for a small, $4.65 for a medium and $5.45 for a large. Prices are our estimates and vary by stand — every 7 Brew is independently owned.

How much sugar is in a 7 Brew Salted Honey Chai Latte?

60 g in a medium.

What is in a Salted Honey Chai Latte?

Chai, milk, honey and salted caramel. The official build line gives it away: 'Honey + Salted Caramel Chai Latte.' The salt in the name comes from the salted caramel, not from anyone salting the honey. The honey itself goes in as honey syrup, which is how stands pour it. If a stand does not know the name, the fallback order is 'a chai latte with honey and salted caramel.'

Is there a sugar-free Salted Honey Chai Latte?

No. The official guide lists no sugar-free version of this drink, and the menu gives the sugar-free badge to Brewchata, not to this one. The reason is simple: sugar-free salted caramel exists, but honey has no sugar-free equivalent. The closest order is half sweet with sugar-free salted caramel, and even that is not a sugar-free drink.

Why is this chai higher in calories than the plain one?

Two syrups instead of none. A medium iced Salted Honey runs 300 calories and 60 g of sugar against the plain Chai Latte's 220 and 37. The honey and salted caramel together add about 80 calories and 23 g of sugar. It is the sweetest of the three named chai builds per cup, until you meet the frozen chiller version of itself at 350.

Can I get it as a frozen chiller?

Yes. The guide lists a Salted Honey Chai Latte Frozen Chiller too: a medium is 350 calories and 77 g of sugar, blended and richer than the iced latte's 300 and 60. Order it blended by name so the stand does not default to iced.

How do I make a salted honey chai latte at home?

Build the chai latte (equal parts chai concentrate and milk), then stir in 1/2 oz honey syrup and 1/2 oz salted caramel syrup. Real honey works at home if you dissolve it while the drink is warm. The full copycat recipe is in the recipe section on this page.
